description:
Class representing a continuous region in a document. 
Each Range object is determined by the position of the start and end characters.

AddBookmark.description: Adds a bookmark to the specified range.

params.description: The bookmark name.
params.name: sName

returns.description: returns false if range is empty.

AddComment.description: Adds a comment to the current range.

params.description: The comment text.
params.name: sText

params.description: The author's name.
params.name: sAuthor

params.description: The user ID of the comment author.
params.name: sUserId

returns.description: Returns null if the comment was not added.

AddComment.signature: AddComment(sText: string, sAuthor?: string, sUserId?: string): ApiComment

AddField.description:
Adds a field to the specified range by the field instruction code.
<note> This method removes text within a range. </note>

params.description: The field instruction code.
params.name: sCode

AddHyperlink.description: Adds a hyperlink to the specified range.

params.description: The link address.
params.name: sLink

params.description: The screen tip text.
params.name: sScreenTipText

params.description: name of a bookmark
params.name: sBookmarkName

returns.description: returns null if range contains more than one paragraph or sLink is invalid.

AddHyperlink.signature: AddHyperlink(sLink: string, sScreenTipText: string, sBookmarkName: string): ApiHyperlink

AddText.description: Adds a text to the specified position.

params.description: The text that will be added.
params.name: text

params.description: The position where the text will be added ("before" or "after" the range specified).
params.name: position

returns.description: returns true if the text was successfully added.

Delete.description: Deletes all the contents from the current range.

returns.description: returns false if range is empty.

ExpandTo.description: Returns a new range that goes beyond the specified range in any direction and spans a different range. The current range has not changed.

params.description: The range that will be expanded.
params.name: oRange

returns.description: returns null if the specified range can't be expanded.

GetAllParagraphs.description: Returns a collection of paragraphs that represents all the paragraphs in the specified range.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiRange class.

GetEndPage.description: Returns the end page number of the current range.

GetEndPos.description: Returns the end position of the current range.

GetParagraph.description: Returns a paragraph from all the paragraphs that are in the range.

params.description: The paragraph position in the range.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns null if position is invalid.

GetRange.description: Returns a Range object that represents the document part contained in the specified range.

params.description: Start position index in the current range.
params.name: Start

params.description: End position index in the current range (if <= 0, then the range is taken to the end).
params.name: End

GetStartPage.description: Returns the start page number of the current range.

GetStartPos.description: Returns the start position of the current range.

GetText.description: Returns a text from the specified range.

params.description: Options for formatting the returned text.
params.name: options

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include numbering or not.
params.name: options_Numbering

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include mathematical expressions or not.
params.name: options_Math

params.description: Defines how the line separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r".
params.name: options_NewLineSeparator

params.description: Defines how the table cell separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\t".
params.name: options_TableCellSeparator

params.description: Defines how the table row separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r\n".
params.name: options_TableRowSeparator

params.description: Defines how the paragraph separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r\n".
params.name: options_ParaSeparator

params.description: Defines how the tab will be specified in the resulting string (does not apply to numbering). Any symbol can be used. The default symbol is "\t".
params.name: options_TabSymbol

returns.description: Returns an empty string if range is empty.

GetText.signature: GetText(options?: object, options_Numbering?: boolean, options_Math?: boolean, options_NewLineSeparator?: string, options_TableCellSeparator?: string, options_TableRowSeparator?: string, options_ParaSeparator?: string, options_TabSymbol?: string): string

GetTextPr.description: Returns the merged text properties of the entire range.

IntersectWith.description: Returns a new range as the intersection of the current range with another range. The current range has not changed.

params.description: The range that will be intersected with the current range.
params.name: oRange

returns.description: returns null if can't intersect.

MoveCursorToPos.description:
Moves a cursor to a specified position of the current range object.
If there is any selection in the document, it will be removed.

params.description: The desired cursor position.
params.name: nPos

Select.description: Sets the selection to the specified range.

SetBold.description: Sets the bold property to the text character.

params.description: Specifies if the Range contents are displayed bold or not.
params.name: isBold

returns.description: returns null if can't apply bold.

SetCaps.description: Specifies that any lowercase characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.

params.description: Specifies if the Range contents are displayed capitalized or not.
params.name: isCaps

returns.description: returns null if can't apply caps.

SetColor.description: Sets the text color to the current text Range.

params.description: The text color.
params.name: color

returns.description: returns null if can't apply color.

SetDoubleStrikeout.description: Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current Range are displayed double struck through or not.
params.name: isDoubleStrikeout

returns.description: returns null if can't apply double strikeout.

SetEndPos.description: Sets the end position of the current range object.

params.description: End position.
params.name: nPos

SetFontFamily.description: Sets all 4 font slots with the specified font family.

params.description: The font family or families used for the current text Range.
params.name: sFontFamily

returns.description: returns null if can't set font family.

SetFontSize.description: Sets the font size to the characters of the current text Range.

params.description: The text size value measured in half-points (1/144 of an inch).
params.name: FontSize

returns.description: returns null if can't set font size.

SetHighlight.description: Specifies a highlighting color which is applied as a background to the contents of the current Range.

params.description: Available highlight color.
params.name: sColor

returns.description: returns null if can't apply highlight.

SetItalic.description: Sets the italic property to the text character.

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current Range are displayed italicized or not.
params.name: isItalic

returns.description: returns null if can't apply italic.

SetPosition.description:
Specifies the amount by which text is raised or lowered for the current Range in relation to the default
baseline of the surrounding non-positioned text.

params.description: Specifies a positive (raised text) or negative (lowered text)measurement in half-points (1/144 of an inch).
params.name: nPosition

returns.description: returns null if can't set position.

SetShd.description: Specifies the shading applied to the contents of the current text Range.

params.description: The shading type applied to the contents of the current text Range.
params.name: type

params.description: The shading color.
params.name: color

returns.description: returns null if can't apply shadow.

SetShd.signature: SetShd(type: ShdType, color: ApiColor): ApiRange | null

SetSmallCaps.description:
Specifies that all the lowercase letter characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital
letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current Range are displayed capitalized two points smaller or not.
params.name: isSmallCaps

returns.description: returns null if can't apply small caps.

SetSpacing.description: Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.

params.description: The value of the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nSpacing

returns.description: returns null if can't apply spacing.

SetStartPos.description: Sets the start position of the current range object.

params.description: Start position.
params.name: nPos

SetStrikeout.description: Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with a single horizontal line through the range center.

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current Range are displayed struck through or not.
params.name: isStrikeout

returns.description: returns null if can't apply strikeout.

SetStyle.description: Sets the style to the current Range.

params.description: The style which must be applied to the text character.
params.name: oStyle

returns.description: returns null if can't set style.

SetTextPr.description: Sets the text properties to the current Range.

params.description: The text properties that will be applied to the current range.
params.name: oTextPr

returns.description: returns null if can't set text properties.

SetUnderline.description:
Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character
(less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current Range are displayed underlined or not.
params.name: isUnderline

returns.description: returns null if can't apply underline.

SetVertAlign.description:
Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the Range contents in relation to the default appearance of the Range text:
**"baseline"** - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned by the default text baseline.
**"subscript"** - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned below the default text baseline.
**"superscript"** - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned above the default text baseline.

params.description: The vertical alignment type applied to the text contents.
params.name: sType

returns.description: returns null if can't apply align.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiRange object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used numberings will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteNumberings

params.description: Specifies if the used styles will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteStyles
